The 1° run should finish in about 75 minutes, and resolution trends show comet GTI flux dropping 6% from 4° to 2° (1.64e8 to 1.55e8), with the 1° result set to complete the study. I'll also run a benchmark applying the preprint's ballistic-corotation remap to my own model's STEREO-A/L1/SolO series, comparing it against the MHD's actual comet output to isolate remap error in an SIR-dominated interval.

  "content": "import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/py"))
import inputs as I
import run_helio as R

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "out_ballistic"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
OMEGA = 14.1844
AU_KM = 1.495978707e8


def track(name):
    e = I.ephem(name)
    return e.t.to_numpy(), np.unwrap(np.radians(e.ecl_lon_deg.to_numpy())) * 180 / np.pi, e.r_au.to_numpy()


def ballistic(ts, v, flux, mon, com):
    tm, lm, rm = mon
    tc, lc, rc = com
    lam_m, r_m = np.interp(ts, tm, lm), np.interp(ts, tm, rm)
    ta = ts.copy()
    for _ in range(30):
        lam_c, r_c = np.interp(ta, tc, lc), np.interp(ta, tc, rc)
        d = (lam_c - lam_m + 180) % 360 - 180
        ta = ts + d / OMEGA * 86400 + (r_c - r_m) * AU_KM / v
    return ta, flux * (r_m / np.interp(ta, tc, rc)) ** 2


def main(run):
    pr = R.probes(R.RUNS / run)
    com = track("3i_atlas")
    c = pr["3i_atlas"]
    win = (I.tsec(I.OBS[0]), I.tsec(I.OBS[1]))
    res = {}
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
    tg = np.arange(I.tsec("2025-11-29"), I.tsec("2025-12-08"), 1800.0)
    utc = I.T_REF + pd.to_timedelta(tg, unit="s")
    truth = np.interp(tg, c.t, c.flux)
    ax.semilogy(utc, truth, "k-", lw=2, label="MHD at comet (truth in model world)")
    w = (tg >= win[0]) & (tg <= win[1])
    res["mhd_comet_window_median"] = float(np.median(truth[w]))
    for b in ("stereo_a", "earth", "solar_orbiter"):
        m = pr[b]
        ok = np.isfinite(m.v.to_numpy()) & (m.t.to_numpy() > I.tsec("2025-11-15"))
        ta, fl = ballistic(m.t.to_numpy()[ok], m.v.to_numpy()[ok], m.flux.to_numpy()[ok], track(b), com)
        o = np.argsort(ta)
        mapped = np.interp(tg, ta[o], fl[o])
        ax.semilogy(utc, mapped, lw=1, label=f"ballistic map of model {b}")
        res[b] = {"window_median": float(np.median(mapped[w])), "ratio_to_mhd": float(np.median(mapped[w]) / np.median(truth[w])), "log_corr_window": float(np.corrcoef(np.log(mapped[w]), np.log(truth[w]))[0, 1]),
                  "rms_log10_err_nov29_dec8": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.log10(mapped / truth) ** 2)))}
    ax.axvspan(pd.Timestamp(I.OBS[0]), pd.Timestamp(I.OBS[1]), color="orange", alpha=0.25)
    ax.set_ylabel("proton flux [cm$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$]")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7)
    ax.set_title("Preprint ballistic-corotation remap applied to model spacecraft series vs MHD at comet", fontsize=9)
    fig.autofmt_xdate()
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / f"ballistic_{run}.png", dpi=130)
    plt.close(fig)
    (OUT / f"ballistic_{run}.json").write_text(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
    return res


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps(main(sys.argv[1]), indent=1))
"

The ballistic remap on my model's STEREO-A series matches the preprint's result closely, but it underestimates the true MHD flux at the comet by about 2x across all three spacecraft due to SIR compression between 0.97–1.87 AU, with low correlation and 0.22–0.32 dex error. I'll now check the figure to visualize this.
